Strategy brain, version 1:
Fixed-limit hold'em, 4 players. Play tight-aggressive.
Preflop: open-raise strong hands (pairs 6+, AK, AQ, KQ, suited broadways) from any seat; play premium hands in late position; fold weak offsuit junk to raises, especially from early seats.
Postflop: bet/raise with top pair or better and strong draws; check-call medium hands in position; fold to heavy multi-way action without a made hand or strong draw.
Bluff occasionally on dry boards when checked to, especially in position.
Don't chase small draws against multiple opponents. Watch opponents: note who raises wide (loose) and who only shows strength (tight), and adjust: call down looser against aggressive bluffers, fold more to tight players' raises.
Keep notes on each game's results and opponent tendencies here.
